about: 蓝白 · 第 7b 幕：海一侧的约定（宫殿系、车的路径、海要的灯位与时刻、_Udon_PalaceVeil）。由 Act07_Sea/Tools~/palace_frame.py 生成。宫殿布局的数据源是宫殿会话的 Palace/PalaceLayout.json；两者冲突时以 PalaceLayout.json 为准，海这边跟着改。

frame.origin: x = bus path, y = terrace top, z = bus origin at F5 (644.96)
frame.axes: Unity: x right (seen from the bus), y up, z = bus heading
frame.placement: R_Palace.localPosition = -busPos(t) (relative to the bus origin; bus at the world origin)

bus_turn.rule: D-34 #5 / D-49 #4 option C (总导演 10-26): the bus steers right into the stop, heading(t) = heading_deg x smoothstep((t - t0) / (t1 - t0)), held after t1 to the exit; it moves along its heading, so bus_samples carry the drift. Only R_Palace turns: R_Palace world rotation = yaw(-heading), world position = yaw(-heading) x (straight-path placement - drift) about the bus origin (the world origin). The sea, the sun, the shafts, the 7c mirror and rose lights do not turn.
bus_turn.written_by: the act-7 driver (sea): LanbaiAct07Driver palaceRoot, every frame from t0 (identity before)

terrace.note: the lip face (x = edge_x, y lip_bottom..0) is solid rock with seaweed; BELOW the lip the terrace has NO underside (dream decision, README): from below, the palace lamps read as a constellation overhead (F7p); the buildings are veiled by fog from below (global _Udon_PalaceVeil, see palace_veil)

door_azimuth_note: from the main eye (0.55, 1.70, 2.05), the bus turned by bus_turn (10-26: was from the bus origin, no turn)

palace_veil.name: _Udon_PalaceVeil

components.x: density per m inside the veil band (0 = none)
components.y: WORLD y of the band top (= R_Palace world y + top_offset_palace_y)
components.z: band thickness m (the band is y - z .. y)

palace_veil.meaning: the fog that veils the palace buildings when seen from BELOW the terrace (the terrace has no underside, F7p). A fragment is veiled by the part of the eye->fragment segment that lies inside the horizontal band: veil = 1 - exp(-x * L_band), L_band = |segment| * clamp-overlap of [y_eye, y_frag] with [y - z, y] / |y_frag - y_eye|. From above the terrace (before F7s) the segment never crosses the band: no veil, automatically.
palace_veil.shader: col = lerp(col, LanbaiHorizon(normalize(posWS - eye)), veil)   (the water fog colour of that direction; after LanbaiApplyFog). The lamp flames (_FogMode 2) do NOT take the veil: from below they are the constellation.

curve.note: 7b-i: the bus is above the terrace
F7p: from below, 13 m of band -> 96 % veiled

palace_veil.writer: the act-7 driver (sea), every frame from F5 to the exit 922.36; w = 1

under_bus_light.follows: nearest avenue pair (by z), from below the floor
under_bus_light.render_mode: Not Important (CONTROL: pixel-light budget; it is the only moving light under the floor)

specks.note: far lights of the drowned city beyond the fog: points 140-650 m away on the terrace (left and ahead), fog-free with own attenuation (_FogMode 2, _Atten 0.004); the same mesh hangs in the act-8 ceiling (Sea README §4)
